method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the First Home Owner Grant Act 2000 (WA) (No. 16 of 2000) as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49121.txt (legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc 49121, retrieved 2026-09-07; compilation table ends with the Help to Buy (Commonwealth Powers) Act 2025 Pt. 4 Div. 2, 19 Dec 2025), with the First Home Owner Grant Regulations 2000 version 03-l0-00 (currency from 14 May 2026) as deposited at ../../../first-home-owner-grant-regulations-2000/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49370.txt: r 6 (cap $800 000 south of the 26th parallel from 7 May 2026) and r 8(3) (12.4%)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the first home buyer: the eligibility criteria (ss 7, 7B, 9-13B, with spouse and de facto partner worked out), the eligible transaction and total value against the cap (ss 14, 14AA-14AD, r 6), entitlement (s 8), the amount (s 19, with the s 19(2) special-class amounts as a table), the application window (s 15(5)), repayment when paid early or before residence (ss 18(3), 21(2)), repayment and penalty (s 51), the interest rate under an arrangement (s 52, r 8(3)), the charge on the home (s 55), the fines (ss 22(4), 47), the objection and review deadlines (ss 28, 31), and the Duties Act 2008 s 142A concessional first home owner test. Not encoded: the s 14B class windows, movable buildings, rr 4, 5 and 7 detail, guardians, death of an applicant, the objection procedure, investigation powers, the charge's priority and sale, grant relief declarations, and administration.
seat: the first home buyer (the applicant for a first home owner grant)
